sourceChecks.text: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名との不一致を固定WEBで確認し、誤対応として除外。

sourceChecks.text: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの各候補箇所を原文と前後の系譜文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの各候補箇所を原文と前後の系譜文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2:42はエラフメエルの兄弟カレブの子らを明記する。前後の系譜から同一人物の可能性はあるが、個々の記述の同一性を断定しない。

sourceChecks.text: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名との不一致を固定WEBで確認し、誤対応として除外。

sourceChecks.text: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名との不一致を固定WEBで確認し、誤対応として除外。

sourceChecks.text: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名との不一致を固定WEBで確認し、誤対応として除外。
